latHint: Think a fake doctor - not a duck sound.
pivHint: A QUACK is the sound a duck makes - but a QUACK is also a fake doctor, a medical ______.
winText: Fake it. QUACK was the pivot - a duck call to a medical FRAUD.
lossText: FRAUD - a deceiver. QUACK was the pivot: a duck QUACK to a QUACK doctor.
